Hi Amelia,

Thanks for the call this morning — good to meet the FintechCorp security team. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

- We're starting the vendor security questionnaire (attached) and will return it with answers by 2026-07-15.
- Please confirm your SOC 2 status (Type/period) and any summary artifacts you can share.
- You asked about our incident response and breach notification timelines — below are the items we'll collect for you:
  - Incident response policy excerpt and point-of-contact
  - Typical customer notification timelines (confirmed vs suspected incidents)
  - BCP/DR runbook and most recent tabletop/test evidence

Could you share: SOC 2 report summary, preferred contact for IR notifications, and any specific evidence template you want filled (e.g., AWS access logs, tabletop minutes)?

I'll loop in our security lead (Marissa) and legal/ops as needed.

Thanks,

Hi Jordan — thanks for the recap.

I've attached our SOC 2 Type II summary (period: 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31). For vendor security we generally require:

- Initial notification of a suspected or confirmed data breach within 72 hours of discovery.
- A preliminary incident summary within 72 hours and a root cause / remediation report within 7 business days for incidents impacting cardholder or customer PII.
- Evidence of BCP/DR exercises from the last 12 months (tabletop minutes or runbook updates).

Contact for incident escalation: security@fintechcorp.com (primary) and Carlos Mendes (Head of Security).

I'll expect the completed questionnaire and any Redwood artifacts by 2026-07-15; happy to schedule a follow-up call next week.

Best,
Amelia Ruiz
Head of Vendor Risk
FintechCorp

Jordan / Neha — attaching the artifacts we can share immediately.

Summary of what we're sending:
- SOC2_Type2_2025_summary.pdf (high-level: CC2/availability, security controls in scope)
- BCP_DR_Runbook.pdf (redacted runbook + tabletop minutes 2025-10-20)

Breach notification / IR timelines (recommended phrasing for questionnaire):
- Initial customer-facing notification: within 24 hours of confirmed material data exposure.
- For suspected incidents, initial notification within 72 hours of discovery as a best-effort; follow-up with a preliminary incident summary within 72 hours and a full remediation report within 7 business days where applicable.
- Contact and escalation: security@redwood.com, ir-lead@redwood.com, legal@redwood.com.

Notes: We avoid promising legal/regulatory timelines (e.g., specific HIPAA breach reporting windows) in public vendor responses — instead we commit to cooperating with regulated customers to meet their obligations and provide timely evidence.

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_2025_summary.pdf, BCP_DR_Runbook.pdf
— Marissa
Marissa Cole

Thanks, Marissa — that's helpful.

A couple of follow-ups:
- Can you confirm encryption at rest (KMS) for customer data and whether keys are customer-managed or Redwood-managed?
- Please provide the most recent tabletop minutes (redacted is fine) and any date-stamped evidence that exercises were conducted within the last 12 months.
- We'll also need the completed vendor questionnaire (preferred: native Excel with answers + a signed attestation). We typically ask for an electronic signature on the attestation section — DocuSign is fine.

If you can get the completed questionnaire and attachments uploaded to the shared drive by EOD 2026-07-15, we can move to Risk review that week.

Best,
Amelia
